title: Battle of Medina de Rioseco
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Medina de Rioseco", at revision 1370449437, opens: "The Battle of Medina de Rioseco, also known as the Battle of Moclín, was fought during the Peninsular War on 14 July 1808 when a combined body of Spanish militia and regulars moved to rupture the French line of communications to Madrid. General Joaquín Blake's Army of Galicia, under joint command with General Gregorio de la Cuesta, was routed by Marshal Bessières after a badly coordinated but stubborn fight against the French corps north of Valladolid." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q246200, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1808 battle during the Peninsular War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
